moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins next weekend, with Arsenal v Coventry City on Friday and Hull City v Manchester United on Saturday as opening fixtures.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off next weekend. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Friday Night Football
angles.copy: Arsenal kick off the new Premier League season next Friday night against Coventry City. Ready for some Gunners action?

angles.name: Saturday Early Kick-off
angles.copy: Hull City host Manchester United in the first Saturday lunchtime kick-off of the Premier League season! Big start for both sides.

moments.title: New Music Friday: Phoebe Bridgers, Ayra Starr & Jungle
moments.blurb: Today marks New Music Friday with significant album releases from Phoebe Bridgers, Ayra Starr, and Jungle, alongside new singles from The Script, Kasabian, and Jordan Rakei.

angles.name: Big Album Drops
angles.copy: New Music Friday is here! What are you spinning first? Fresh albums from Phoebe Bridgers, Ayra Starr, and Jungle are out now.

angles.name: Phoebe Bridgers Album
angles.copy: Six years in the making! Phoebe Bridgers drops her third solo album today. Tune in for new tracks.

angles.name: Jungle Vibes
angles.copy: Get ready to move! Jungle's new album 'Sunshine' has landed on New Music Friday. Perfect for your weekend playlist.

moments.title: UK Heatwave Continues for Some, Fresher Air Arriving
moments.blurb: After an amber extreme heat warning on Thursday, fresher air moves across the UK today and into the weekend, though parts of southeastern England could still see temperatures in the low-to-mid 30s.

angles.name: Heatwave Easing
angles.copy: The heatwave is slowly easing for many, but parts of the South East could still hit the low 30s today. Stay cool and hydrated!

angles.name: Devon Heat
angles.copy: Devon, are you feeling the heat today? Fresher air is on the way, but it's still warm out there. Stay safe in the sun!

angles.name: Warmest Summer on Record?
angles.copy: Could this be the UK's warmest summer on record? The Met Office says it's 'increasingly likely' after sustained periods of heat. What's been your favourite summer moment so far?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Preparations Underway
moments.blurb: Preparations for the 2026 series of Strictly Come Dancing are in full swing, with professional dancer routines being pre-recorded this month ahead of the launch show in September.

angles.name: Strictly Anticipation
angles.copy: Glitterball season is coming! Strictly Come Dancing is busy recording pro routines this month, building excitement for the September launch. Who are you hoping to see on the dancefloor?

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: This year's Strictly will see new hosts Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe, and Josh Widdicombe take the reins! Big changes in the ballroom!

moments.title: Reacher Season 4 UK Premiere This Week
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated fourth season of the action-packed series 'Reacher', based on Lee Child's 'Gone Tomorrow', premiered in the UK this week.

angles.name: Reacher Is Back
angles.copy: Jack Reacher is back! Season 4, based on 'Gone Tomorrow', premiered in the UK this week. Have you started watching the new series?

angles.name: New Crime Drama
angles.copy: Looking for your next crime drama fix? 'Reacher' Season 4 is a UK premiere this week, diving into a complex and deadly new game.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shaun Ryder (Happy Mondays)
moments.blurb: Shaun Ryder, frontman of Happy Mondays and Black Grape, celebrates his 64th birthday on August 23rd.

angles.name: Madchester Icon
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to the Madchester legend, Shaun Ryder! What's your favourite Happy Mondays or Black Grape track?

angles.name: Still Buzzin'
angles.copy: From 'Step On' to 'Reverend Black Grape', wishing a very Happy 64th Birthday to Shaun Ryder!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Julian Casablancas (The Strokes)
moments.blurb: Julian Casablancas, lead singer of The Strokes, turns 48 on August 23rd.

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a Happy 48th Birthday to The Strokes' iconic frontman, Julian Casablancas! What's your go-to Strokes anthem?

angles.name: 00s Legend
angles.copy: From 'Last Nite' to 'Reptilia', Happy 48th Birthday to Julian Casablancas! Still sounds as fresh as ever.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Rick Springfield
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter and actor Rick Springfield, known for hits like 'Jessie's Girl', celebrates his 77th birthday on August 23rd.

angles.name: Jessie's Girl Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Rick Springfield! 'Jessie's Girl' is still an absolute classic.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Rick Springfield! What's your favourite hit from his incredible career?

moments.title: Summer Holidays Continue Across UK, Scotland Back to School
moments.blurb: While pupils in Scotland have largely returned to school this week, summer holidays are still in full swing for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, with most returning in early September.

angles.name: Still Summer Fun
angles.copy: Sun's out (mostly!) and school's out for many across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland! How are you making the most of the last few weeks of summer holidays?

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: For our Scottish listeners, it's back to school this week! Hope you had a fantastic summer break!

angles.name: Devon Summer
angles.copy: Devon, still soaking up the summer holidays? What's been your favourite family day out in the county?

moments.title: New Episodes: The Chelsea Detective & The Hardacres
moments.blurb: Popular UK dramas 'The Chelsea Detective' Season 4 and 'The Hardacres' Season 2 continue with new episodes streaming this week, offering ongoing mysteries and period drama.

angles.name: Mid-Week Mystery
angles.copy: Catch up on the latest from 'The Chelsea Detective' Season 4 with new episodes streaming this week. Who do you think did it?

angles.name: Period Drama Fix
angles.copy: If you're loving 'The Hardacres' Season 2, new episodes are out this week! Dive back into the world of the Yorkshire elite.
